_comment: The eight founder-facing need areas, carried over from the concept mocks
that Ignition reviewed. 'tags' lists the expertise-sheet values that map to
each area. scripts/build_clinicians.py fails the build if a clinician tag
matches no area and is not listed in sector_tags, so a re-uploaded bench
'prompt' is the question shown to founders; 'strength' is the affirming
phrasing used when a founder scores well in this area.

areas.label: Idea & validation
areas.prompt: Is this a real opportunity, and who is it for?
areas.strength: You have a clear read on the opportunity

areas.label: Business model & strategy
areas.prompt: How will this actually make money?
areas.strength: Your business model is well thought through

areas.label: Product & technology
areas.prompt: Can we build it — and should we build it this way?
areas.strength: You have a solid handle on what you're building

areas.label: Marketing, brand & sales
areas.prompt: How do we reach customers and get them to buy?
areas.strength: You know how to reach your customers

areas.label: IP & legal
areas.prompt: How do we protect the idea and structure the business?
areas.strength: Your IP and legal position is in good shape

areas.label: Funding & finance
areas.prompt: Where does the money come from — grants, R&D, investors?
areas.strength: You have a credible funding path

areas.label: Pitch & story
areas.prompt: Can I explain this in a way that lands?
areas.strength: You can tell your story well

areas.label: You & your team
areas.prompt: Am I set up to lead this — and who do I need around me?
areas.strength: You and your team are well set up

_sector_comment: Domain tags that describe the industry a clinician knows rather than a
capability a founder needs. They never drive area matching, but they are
shown on the expert card and are useful for a sector-aware tiebreak.
_alias_comment: Typos and spelling variants found in the 2026 expertise spreadsheet,
mapped to the canonical tag. Fix these in the source sheet when you can;
until then this table keeps the matching correct. A value of null splits
a compound field that used commas inside a slash-separated list.
_stages_comment: Where the founder says their venture is up to, used by the guided pathway.
'likelyGaps' are the areas that most commonly need work at that stage. They
never override what the founder actually tells us - they only decide the
running order when someone names fewer than three concerns, so the third
recommendation is a sensible guess rather than an alphabetical accident.
Tune these freely; they are a heuristic, not a diagnosis.

stages.label: It's an idea
stages.description: Nothing tested yet - I want to know if it is worth pursuing.

stages.label: I'm testing it
stages.description: Talking to potential customers, running early experiments.

stages.label: I'm building it
stages.description: Product in progress, maybe first sales.

stages.label: Existing business, new direction
stages.description: Diversifying products or markets, or spinning out a venture.
